issues.title: LO-17: Storage nameStr_ backing String move-safety risk
issues.body:
Copied from https://github.com/JN0V/DomoticsCore/issues/171 for a trial of workline's line on this copy.

| LO-17 | Storage | `nameStr_` backing String — move-safety risk |

Opened from `docs/CODE-ROADMAP.md`, lines 6337 to 6337 by the product-owner role.

<!-- workline:import=docs/CODE-ROADMAP.md:ad8aaf585409 -->

## Need

An application that creates several named Storage instances and moves or copies them should not end up with a dangling component name.

## Verification

Native tests on `StorageComponent`, each reading `metadata.name` after the original is destroyed, so a pointer into the old object's String would dangle:
- **Copy, named:** build one with a `componentName`, copy-construct it, destroy the original, then check the copy's `metadata.name` still reads the same name. This fails if the copy keeps a pointer into the original's `nameStr_`.
- **Move, named:** build one with a `componentName`, move-construct it, destroy the moved-from object, then check the new object's `metadata.name` reads the same name and points into its own `nameStr_`.
- **Default name (regression guard):** build one with no `componentName`, copy it and move it, destroy the originals, then check `metadata.name` still reads "Storage". This passes today; it keeps a fix from breaking the literal.
- If copy and move assignment are supported, the same named checks run after assignment.

## Validation

- **Copy keeps the name:** Given a StorageComponent built with a componentName, When it is copy-constructed and the original is destroyed, Then the copy's metadata.name still reads the same name.
- **Move keeps the name:** Given a StorageComponent built with a componentName, When it is move-constructed, Then the new object's metadata.name reads the same name and does not point into the old object's String.
- **Default name:** Given a StorageComponent built with no componentName, When it is copied or moved, Then metadata.name still reads "Storage".

## Scope

StorageComponent constructor: `nameStr_` holds the dynamic componentName and `metadata.name` stores the pointer from nameStr_.c_str()

## Assumptions

- Assumption taken on 2026-11-04, the Need and Validation drafts unanswered after 5 min: written as the role drafted it, for a person to correct.
